points.guidance:
Allow ‘=’ in working but need an inequality in the answer.

Allow $0 < p \leqslant \frac{5}{23}$.

points.text:
e.g.

$$0.5 - 2.3p, \; 0 \text{ to } a \qquad p + 1.3p, \; a \text{ to } 3 \qquad 2 \times 1.3p, \; 2 \times (b \text{ to } 3) \qquad 2.3p + 1.3p, \; a \text{ to } 3 + b \text{ to } 3$$

$$2p + 2.6p, \; 2 \times (a \text{ to } 3) \qquad 0.5 - 1.3p, \; 0 \text{ to } b \qquad 0.5 + 1.3p, \; b \text{ to } 6$$
points.guidance: Any correct expression for the probability of a relevant region.

Attempt to integrate with correct limits and equate to $\frac{5}{27}$, oe.

Integrate from 2 to $6 - a$ and equate $\frac{18}{5}p = \frac{2}{3}$.

Integrate from $a$ to 3 and equate to $\frac{23}{54}$.

Integrate from 0 to $a$ and equate to $\frac{2}{27}$.
For integrating and substitution of limits to form cubic in $a$.
Any correct three term cubic equation in $a$.
Attempt to factorise their cubic equation.
**SC B1** for $a = 1$ only, if no method seen for solving the cubic.
